description:
Use this when you need an auditable Canada federal baseline count for a pinned year. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need provincial, private-employer or schedule-specific substitute-day semantics.
What it computes: Counts baseline working and non-working dates for federally regulated-employer general holidays in 2026-2027.
Example user requests: Count Canada federal working days from 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-02.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-09-28","end_date":"2026-10-02","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: normalized_start_date, normalized_end_date, working_days, non_working_days, federal_general_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_observed, holiday_actual_dates, weekend_days, rest_day_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += Canada federal status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/canada-federal-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/canada-federal-working-days-between.md
name: count_canada_federal_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, regular weekend or Canada federal general holiday.

holiday_names.description: Canada Labour Code general holidays applying on the date.

holiday_observed.description: False because substitute dates depend on schedule and agreement and are not inferred.

non_working_days.description: Weekend and Canada federal general-holiday dates.

rest_day_policy.description: Scheduled-workday and employer substitution rules are not inferred.

sources.description: Official Canada.ca and Canada Labour Code sources.

substitute_day_policy.description: Canada.ca rule summary with schedule-dependent boundary.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Canada Federal Working Days
